candidateIdentity: Containing commit plus exact source hashes; current focused evidence, not full-suite or changed-head hosted acceptance.
applicability: Risk-enabled builds; risk remains disabled by default.

repair.cause: The priority queue releases consumed states and witnesses already share parents, but witnessesByState retained completed depth layers as an arena.
repair.invariant: Depth is the first queue priority and every edge advances one depth. At the first pop at depth d, deduplication keys for destinations at depth d can no longer be queried by any remaining parent. Clearing that index retains ancestry through actual descendants and preserves all current-depth alternate admission.
repair.meaning: No change to risk propagation meaning, cap semantics, formats, public options or version 7.

measurement.sourceComparison: Original 8e0186 producer versus repaired producer with the same real factories and scalar observation hooks.
measurement.representationControl: Independent copied-prefix arrays and consumed-state-retaining heap use the current reconciled engine admission and ordering. This is a controlled representation baseline, not an exact historical engine throughput claim.
measurement.probes: Original Map membership and actual witness/queue factories. WeakSet/WeakMap observers do not own nodes. Only numeric data leaves the invocation; index/queue references are released in finally.
measurement.heap: Sampled process heap during compute; process RSS high-water includes startup. No exact peak or GC attribution claim. Deep reachability samples describe witness nodes and path slots reachable from index/queue, not the whole heap.
measurement.deepDisabled: In measured light probes peakRetainedWitnessNodes/peakRetainedPathSlots remain zero because graph reachability sampling is disabled; the separate15-case deep campaign owns those measurements.
measurement.cpu: Raw user/system microseconds, wall milliseconds, before/after/collected heap and lifetime RSS are retained. Validation runs after measured resource capture.
measurement.outcome: Index lifetime and representation work bounds improve. Timing is mixed; no general latency or end-to-end throughput improvement is qualified.
measurement.immutableInputs: Each scope has identical input and output digests across all54 original/candidate/control fresh-process samples.

coverage.preserved: Full result comparison excludes only stats.generatedAt and stats.timingMs, whose producer explicitly derives them from invocation Date.now. Flow/partial IDs, exact arrays/order/watch fields, caps, statuses, counts and referenced Set insertion order remain exact.
coverage.ownership: All51 new cases and nine restored original risk cases retain explicit ci-lite membership. The36 actual measurement cases use the existing serial runtime budget owner; thresholds and deadlines are unchanged.

publicationChecks.originalFailure: Roadmap CRLF size exceeded20000 bytes. Completed duplicate summaries were compacted, retaining their linked receipts; check and affected contract-matrix pass.

historicalPaths: Author-workspace .tmp/.testLogs paths are provenance only and are not promised in clean checkouts.
excluded: No editor, Tantivy, WSL/Linux execution, optional backend or release qualification is claimed.

hosted.nativeAndAuthority: All three native inspection jobs, Windows native index, Windows authority, gate and Rust pass.
hosted.remaining: Windows broad in progress at capture; Ubuntu long crash-log p95 250.208ms exceeds unchanged250ms; eight macOS source authority cases fail real compiler binding positives. Their original hosted logs are retained for next repair batch.
hosted.relation: Different owner from risk witness retention; not a current head all-green claim.
